title: Modern Destruction Corps

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
S.l., S.M.P. D. Station, 5837
Date Apr. Date 24/11/1934 ML）
Subject (in full) Modern Destruction Corps
Made by D.I. Sin Tse-liang Forwarded by W Duncan DSS

In connection with the attached, discreet enquiries
made in all circles have failed to confirm rumours of the
existence in Shanghai of a "Modern Destruction Corps".
It is learned that the local Kuomintang has received a
confidential order from Mr. Waung Ching-wei, President
of the Executive Yuan, instructing that strong measures be
adopted to suppress any such organization especially in
Shanghai, the commercial centre of China where foreign
interests are abundant.
According to the local Kuomihtang there is no such
organization at present in Shanghai despite newspaper
reports which have most probably been inserted by reporters
based upon rumours. The only cities where these bodies
are known to be active are Peiping, Nanking and Hangchow.

（批：file
J）
Sih Tse Liang
D. I.
Officer i/c Special Branch.
page_data.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处
档案号：C. & S. B. 登记处。
地点：上海，工部局警务处 D 巡捕房，5837
日期：1934年11月24日 ML）
主题（全称）现代破坏团
由特别股督察长辛子良（Sin Tse-liang）呈报，经副警务处长 W. Duncan 转呈

就附件事宜而言，经在各阶层进行秘密查访，未能证实有关上海存在“现代破坏团”的谣言。据悉，当地国民党已收到行政院院长汪精卫先生下达的密令，指示采取严厉措施镇压任何此类组织，尤其是在外国利益众多的中国商业中心上海。
据当地国民党称，尽管报纸上有报道，但上海目前并无此类组织，这些报道极有可能是记者根据谣言编造并刊登的。已知此类团体活跃的城市仅有北平、南京和杭州。

（批注：归档
J）
辛子良（Sih Tse Liang）
督察长
特别股主管。

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, FRIDAY, APRIL 13, 1934
In spite of the fact that Mr.
Wang Ching-wei recently con-
demned those who were engaging
in a dress spoiling campaign
against Chinese ladies wearing
fashionable clothes made of for-
eign materials, it is reported that
an organization has recently been
formed in Shanghai to carry on
the "dress slashing" work. Accord-
ing to Chinese newspaper reports,
the organization has chosen the
name of "Modern Destruction
Corps."
（批：附）
（批：S/ Knowlton 4/3）
（批：Who 14 4/34.）

《字林西报》，1934年4月13日，星期五
尽管汪精卫先生最近谴责了那些针对穿着由外国面料制成的时尚服装的中国女士开展“毁衣运动”的人，但有报道称，上海最近成立了一个组织来继续开展“剪衣”工作。据中文报纸报道，该组织已选定“现代破坏团”这一名称。
（批注：附）
（批注：S/ Knowlton 4/3）
（批注：Who 14 4/34.）
